input.headline: Ute 3 is a day late, so delivery IN-77 lands 12 Nov, not 11 Nov. Four jobs wait on it.

affected.why: Ute 3 carries delivery IN-77, which was due 11 Nov.
Ute 3 is Crew A's ute, so Crew A loses its vehicle for a day.
IN-77 holds stock for TES-101, due 12 Nov. Arriving that day leaves no slack.
IN-77 holds the Clipsal Switchboard for TES-102, due 12 Nov. No slack.
IN-77 holds the Symo inverter for TES-103, due 13 Nov. One day of slack.
IN-77 holds the Backup Switch for TES-104, due 14 Nov. Two days of slack.
Maya Chen is the customer for TES-101, which is at risk.
Daniel Wilson is the customer for TES-102, which is at risk.
Wattle Creek School is the customer for TES-103.
Red Plains Cattle Station is the customer for TES-104.
Crew B works TES-102 and may wait on the switchboard.
Crew C works TES-104, due 14 Nov.
